title: Aria
subtitle: A single round brilliant, given room to hold the light on its own.
description: A ring built around one round brilliant and the space to let it work. Bez Ambar sets the stone high and clean in eighteen-karat white gold, the shank kept quiet so nothing draws attention from the centre. The cut does the rest — light gathered and returned in full, bright flashes that shift as the hand moves. It is a design that trusts a single well-cut diamond to carry the entire piece, and asks only that the setting stay out of its way.
